jobs.description: Lead Incentive Compensation AnalystCompany OverviewWe are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potentialPosition OverviewWelcome to Foundational Sales – a new global organization at Siemens level. Our mission is to build ONE Sales Fabric: a consistent, scalable, and data-driven go-to-market foundation that empowers our Sales Units to win in their Verticals and markets – and that makes it easier for our customers to do business with Siemens. Our work spans five focus areas – Process & Data Domain, Sales Enablement & Activation, Digital Sales Channel, Vertical Governance & Operations, and Partner Sales. Together, we create the shared standards, systems, and AI-enabled capabilities behind one coordinated face to the customer. Do you want to help redefine how a global tech company sells in the AI era? Then join us – and through radical collaboration and the “Together, unless” principle, help unlock the power of ONE.Process & Data Domain sets clear common standards for internal-facing processes, data, and the application backbone – acting as the business interface to IT for how common sales applications and related data fit together across the company.Within it, Global Sales Applications owns the main global sales tools – including Salesforce CRM, ICM / Anaplan, rebate management, and quoting applications – and works with IT DevOps and FS SEA to maintain, improve, roll out, and train users on these applications.What we offer you: At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.Key ResponsibilitiesHow you will make an impact with us as Incentive Compensation Analyst:Incentive Compensation Administration• Administer incentive compensation plans, quotas and crediting rules across Sales Units – supporting accurate compensation calculations, payout execution and dispute resolution in line with agreed governance controls.• Maintain compensation documentation, plan rules and governance records, ensuring the incentive framework stays current, auditable and aligned with business decisions made by Sales Finance, HR and Sales leadership.• Configure compensation rules, sales hierarchies, quota assignments and attainment calculations within the incentive management platform, working with IT DevOps to implement and test changes accurately.• Support annual plan rollouts – coordinating plan communication, compensation statement generation and user onboarding activities across Sales Units.Platform & Process Management• Support the incentive management platform (ICM / Anaplan) and related business processes – maintaining system configurations, resolving operational issues and coordinating enhancements with IT DevOps.• Partner with Salesforce CRM, ERP, Payroll and HR teams to maintain end-to-end process integrity across the incentive compensation lifecycle – from quota assignment and crediting through payout and reconciliation.• Gather and document business requirements from Sales, Finance and HR, translating compensation plan logic and business rules into platform configurations and process specifications.• Identify process gaps, data inconsistencies and integration issues between the incentive platform and connected systems, and coordinate resolution with the relevant IT and business stakeholders.Data, Reporting & User Support• Monitor compensation, territory and quota data quality – applying governance standards and resolving data issues that could affect calculation accuracy or payout integrity.• Maintain compensation reports, performance dashboards and payout analytics that give Sales management and Finance clear, timely visibility of incentive outcomes.• Analyse payout trends, attainment distributions and process exceptions to identify improvement opportunities and support fact-based decisions on compensation plan design.• Respond to compensation enquiries from sales teams and managers, providing clear, accurate and timely resolution of calculation questions, disputes and plan clarifications.Qualifications• Three or more years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Compensation Administration, Finance or Commercial Operations, with direct involvement in incentive compensation programs.• Hands-on experience supporting sales compensation and incentive management processes, including quota management, crediting, attainment calculation, payout execution and dispute resolution.• Experience with incentive management or planning platforms such as Anaplan, Xactly, Varicent or CaptivateIQ; familiarity with Salesforce CRM is a plus.• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience working with large datasets and delivering accurate, timely performance and compensation reporting.• Confidence working across Sales, Finance, HR and IT teams, with the ability to translate complex compensation logic into clear platform configurations and process documentation.• University degree in a relevant discipline; advanced degree is a plus. High proficiency in written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!We are Siemens:At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world.You’ll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We’re committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!.The salary range for this position is $102,500 to $184,500 and this role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate’s job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global WorkforceWe value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday#LI-Remote#LI-CM

Senior/ Principal Manager Medical & Scientific Writing*OVERVIEWWe are currently seeking a Senior or Principal Manager Medical & Scientific Writing* to join our Clinical Sciences team with a primary focus on Phase III clinical trials and Biologics License Application (BLA) submissions. You will work in Tübingen, Munich or remote within Germany in an interdisciplinary environment with colleagues from clinical and non-clinical teams and will contribute to our mission of delivering novel PRAME immunotherapies to patients with cancer.This position is offered on a fixed-term contract for 24 months.As a part of cross-functional teams, you will independently manage assigned medical writing activities mainly for late-stage clinical trials and associated regulatory submissions. You work independently, collaborate effectively across functions, manage complex reviews and timelines, and thrive in a dynamic, quality-driven environment. Experience using AI-assisted tools for medical writing and document quality control is an advantage.The final appointment level (Senior Manager or Principal Manager) will be aligned with the successful candidate’s experience and scope of responsibility.We are the global leader in precision targeting of PRAME.
